values.en: Proof Irrelevance is a Separate Principle
values.zh-CN: 证明无关性是独立原则

values.en: Lean builds proof irrelevance into definitional equality: any two proofs of the same proposition are treated as equal by the kernel. Other CIC-style systems may expose proof irrelevance differently or require an additional principle. In either case, proof irrelevance is not a consequence of impredicativity alone and should not be used to define impredicativity.
values.zh-CN: Lean 把证明无关性内建到依定义相等中：同一命题的任意两个证明都由内核视为相等。其他 CIC 风格系统可能以不同方式提供证明无关性，或需要额外原则。无论采用哪种设计，证明无关性都不是非直谓性本身的推论，也不应被用来定义非直谓性。
